shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat surface
justification: The only real correspondences are generic: both involve human form and both carry shallow relief motifs including roundels (rosette band in A, a ring-like disc among the carvings on B). A depicts a repeated procession of profile figures in patterned robes carrying bowls and clasping hands in an ordered horizontal register, while B is a single massive frontal/rear-viewed human effigy whose surface bears isolated, abstract, non-narrative devices with no register order or interaction between elements.
